projects.name: WalleSmart
projects.verification: The platform is operational in 2026. The WALLeSmart 4 research phase ran from 1 April 2023 to 15 October 2025. Platform operation and research funding are distinct. The former CRA-W event link now returns an obsolete-event page; the active May 2026 platform article documents operational applications.

projects.name: AI4BRAIN
projects.verification: UMONS lists MedReSyst/AI4Brain among ongoing projects and describes active work in March 2026. 2021–2027 identifies the funding programme, not a confirmed project end date. The unsupported 2023–2026 project range was removed.

projects.name: ARIAC
projects.verification: UMONS lists TRAIL/ARIAC as ongoing. The TRAIL researcher charter documents SPW funding for 2021–2026; the precise end date is not stated.

projects.name: TSV — Track Sentry Vision
projects.verification: SPW confirms project name and railway-inspection scope. A September 2024 presentation establishes its existence before 2025. Neither current status nor the old 2025–2028 range is confirmed by these public sources; that date range was removed.

projects.name: SiTies — Secure IoT for Smart Cities
projects.verification: The Polish official research registry records Enhancing IoT Systems Security (SiTies), SPS MYP G6259, from 1 September 2024 to 31 August 2027.

projects.name: ROAD-STEP
projects.status: Listed as ongoing by CTA Strée
projects.verification: CTA Strée currently lists Road Step under ongoing projects. UMONS records the initial 2018–2021 funding phase; CRA-W describes further work in 2023. A final end date has not been confirmed. The unsupported 2018–2024 range was removed; ongoing status is explicitly attributed to the partner.

projects.name: FEDER-IDEES
projects.verification: UMONS documents the 2014–2021 project period. The previous start year 2015 was corrected.

projects.name: IMOTION (Chist-Era)
projects.verification: CHIST-ERA specifies October 2013 with a 36-month planned duration, giving 2013–2016. UMONS lists iMotion as completed.

projects.name: ARC OLIMP
projects.verification: The 2011 Designer Forum proceedings explicitly identify ARC-OLIMP as a 2008–2013 research action.

projects.name: FEDER-TIC
projects.verification: Retained in the historical section from the existing SMART’ILIA catalogue. No authoritative public source confirming the old 2010–2014 period was found; those dates were removed. Archival placement is not an independently verified completion status.
